children: First Merchants entered into an Underwriting Agreement with Piper Sandler to offer $100 million of 6.750% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036. The registered public offering is being conducted under the company's shelf registration on Form S-3. The agreement provides for the sale of the notes to the underwriters on customary conditions, supporting the company's capital and funding plans.
: $100,000,000 underwriting agreement for 6.750% subordinated notes due 2036
: Piper Sandler, as representative of the underwriters
: Raise capital and enhance funding flexibility
